enchantments.tooltip: Enhanced Spot +5: Passive: +5 Enhancement bonus to the Spot skill.
Seeker +6: Provides a +6 Enhancement bonus to confirm critical hits, and a +6 Enhancement bonus to critical hit damage (before multipliers are applied).
Mind Turbulence: This item fills your mind with chaos, disrupting your thoughts and causing a -10 Concentration penalty.
Taint of Chaos: Lawful aligned characters equipping this item suffer a temporary negative level until the item is removed.
Rune Arm Imbue: Acid IV: Wearing this Rune Arm will imbue any weapon you wield, dealing 2d8 points of acid damage per hit.
This Rune Arm is craftable and can be customized using recipes at standard crafting devices after disjuncting.
